bagPolicy.summary: T-Mobile Arena prohibits bags or backpacks except for small personal bags measuring up to 9″ x 5″ x 2″. Fanny packs, crossbody bags, and clear stadium bags are allowed if they meet size requirements.
allowed: small personal bags (9″ x 5″ x 2″ max)
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at T-Mobile Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in T-Mobile Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at T-Mobile Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA accessible. Accessible seating throughout. Elevators, ramps, accessible restrooms on every level. ADA drop-off at East Suite Entrance via NY-NY parking garage.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Strict no re-entry for all events.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: East and West entrances. ADA drop-off at East Suite Entrance. Rideshare pickup post-event at New York-New York or Park MGM.
